description:
I’m Jack Calloway, an ex-contractor with 41 years of experience working on homes. I’ve seen the shortcuts, the overpriced repairs, and the small problems homeowners were told to ignore until they became expensive ones.

On this channel, I show you what to check before you hire a contractor, what questions to ask before you approve a repair, and which jobs you may not need to pay someone to do at all. No contractor jargon. Just the things I wish every homeowner knew before the bill arrived.

Subscribe to get the unfiltered truth, beat the pricing loopholes, and master the trade secrets the industry tries to keep hidden.

For business inquiries: elaborateservices@gmail.com
